stem: Find the point P on the $x$-axis equidistant from A(−2, 1) and B(3, 4), and plot it.
solution: P is on the x-axis, so P = (s, 0).

hints.text: A point on the x-axis has y = 0; the unknown is its first coordinate.
Check the signs when you expand the squares.
Set AP² equal to BP² using the distance formula, then solve for s.
